rules.rule: Siphon is a Unity fast-movement team shooter. Report only concrete correctness bugs introduced by this diff, with a reproducible failure scenario and precise code location. Focus on broken Unity references, movement/combat regressions, save compatibility, resource accounting, bot navigation/sensing, and duplicate paid generation requests. Prefer at most five findings for the entire review; do not pad the result with style, documentation, speculative risks, or accepted gameplay tuning changes. Distinguish observed evidence from unverified claims. Review is advisory: do not edit files, apply fixes, approve, merge, or resolve review threads.
